title: Hacker House Medellín public web
description: Server-rendered maud + HTMX public entry, onboarding, reservation partials, health/readiness, and websocket routes. HTML, redirect, form, and websocket surfaces remain client:false while still being held in lockstep with the Rust router.

join_individual.summary: Render the secure individual entry page.

join_organization.summary: Render the secure organization entry page.

auth_start.summary: Validate origin, CSRF, and anti-abuse proof before redirecting to Shared Auth.

onboarding_individual.summary: Resolve a Shared Auth session and render individual onboarding.

onboarding_organization.summary: Resolve a Shared Auth session and render organization onboarding.

list_reservations_partial.summary: Render the authenticated reservation list fragment.

create_reservation_partial.summary: Create a bounded reservation item and re-render the authenticated list fragment.

chat_events.summary: Alias websocket surface for authenticated chat/realtime refresh.
